svg.text: Back face: the face that goes on the mounting plate. Measure from it,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and sideways from the centre line.

svg.text: Bottom face, four 20 mm holes for M20 glands: 40 and 100 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back face, 105 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vent: one 12 mm hole 130 mm from the back face on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof: one 16 mm hole for the antenna, 75 mm from the back face and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the faces, pilot drill 3 mm with wood behind, open out with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: step drill at low speed. No solvents: polycarbonate crazes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the lug kit to the four back corners as its maker describes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each hole size against the part's datasheet; no cracks.
